summary: Frontend-only verification of newly imported Japan + South Korea Thrillophilia trip pages. Japan listing shows 48 package ideas, no broken images; all 9 newly imported Japan detail routes return 200 with correct h1 (the request-stated slug 'journey-north-tohoku-hokkaido' actually resolves to the real slug 'journey-north-through-tohoku-and-hokkaido' which is what the listing card links to and which renders perfectly with 8 day tabs). South Korea listing shows exactly 3 holidays (Korea and Japan Short Group Tour, Korea and Japan with Hiroshima, Japan and South Korea Discovery). The 3 combination trip detail pages render the correct number of day tabs (8, 11, 13) and all day/hero images load (0 broken out of 85/94/100 images). Header search returns 'Japan' and 'South Korea' suggestions. No render-breaking console errors.
action_items: Minor: the review-request stated slug '/asien/journey-north-tohoku-hokkaido' does not match the exported slug 'journey-north-through-tohoku-and-hokkaido'. The real slug (what the Japan listing card links to) works correctly, so this is only a note that the request's URL list was slightly stale, not a product bug.
critical_code_review_comments: tripIndex.js is now ~320 lines of flat imports and spreads. Consider auto-aggregating trip modules via a dynamic require.context / Vite glob import to avoid maintaining a 150+ line hand-written registry.
japanToursData.js japanProducts array is a single ~160-column line with 48 entries - difficult to review in diff; recommend one entry per line.

App.js uses a catch-all `/asien/:slug` route that renders EgyptDetail.jsx; this means any unknown slug silently renders the Egypt page (as observed with the stale URL). Consider rendering a NotFound component when BY_SLUG[slug] is missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Japan listing path /asien/japan/holidays shows 48 cards. South Korea listing /asien/south-korea/holidays shows 3 cards. All imported detail routes resolve via tripIndex.BY_SLUG; EgyptDetail.jsx is the shared detail renderer. If a slug is missing from BY_SLUG, the Egypt listing is rendered as a silent fallback (observed with slug typo). Day tab counts verified for the 3 SK combo trips (8/11/13). No broken images in any of the pages tested.
rca of the issue: The URL /asien/journey-north-tohoku-hokkaido in the test request rendered the Egypt tours page because that slug is NOT registered in BY_SLUG. The actual exported slug for that trip is 'journey-north-through-tohoku-and-hokkaido' (japanToursData japanProducts list and the listing cards link to the correct one). Mitigation: update tester-provided URL list OR add a 404 fallback in EgyptDetail.jsx when BY_SLUG[slug] is undefined so stale URLs are not silently masked.
